The evidence should be excluded because under FRE 404(b) prior bad acts cannot be used to show propensity or that the defendant acted in conformity therewith, which is the prosecution's stated purpose. The note's claim that such evidence is never admissible in the prosecution's case-in-chief is incorrect—FRE 414 permits evidence of prior child molestation offenses in child molestation cases, subject to FRE 403 balancing, but here the prosecution offers it solely for propensity, so it remains inadmissible.
CONFIDENCE: 95
